title: Offer message
description: A negotiation message. Offers are messages, not card fields. There is NO agent-level accept state: the only acceptance the protocol can express is 'accepted-by-human'. Declines carry no reason field - by design (anti-probing): a reasoned decline would let an agent binary-search the counterparty's private reserve or budget. 'additionalProperties: false' makes a decline reason structurally impossible.

state.description: Offer lifecycle. 'proposed' -> 'awaiting-human' -> 'accepted-by-human' | 'declined'; 'withdrawn' is available to the proposer before acceptance. Agents propose; only humans accept.

message.description: Optional provenance-labelled free text accompanying the offer.
